title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director

quotes.text: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board.
quotes.for: Nvidia announcement reinstating Jensen Huang as president, CEO and director effective immediately.

quotes.text: The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA.
quotes.for: Unanimous board vote after meetings satisfied directors regarding Huang candor and leadership.

quotes.text: In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.
quotes.for: Input from senior levels of the U.S. government and board confidence of no national security risk.

quotes.text: The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,
quotes.for: Board chair Harvey C. Jones statement on stakeholder interests.

quotes.text: We are grateful to Colette Kress for her outstanding service as interim CEO, in addition to her continuing responsibilities as NVIDIA’s Chief Financial Officer.” Harvey Jones will remain as Board chair.
quotes.for: Colette Kress continuing as CFO and Harvey C. Jones remaining board chair.

quotes.text: I take this responsibility with the greatest humility and renewed commitment. I want to thank the NVIDIA Board for its confidence and deliberation through this process.
quotes.for: Jensen Huang statement on returning with humility and renewed commitment.

quotes.text: The Board reiterated that the committee’s investigation will proceed to conclusion. Mr. Huang fully supports the investigation and is committed to cooperating with it.
quotes.for: Independent board committee investigation proceeding to conclusion with Huang cooperating.

quotes.text: The Board also recently formed a National Security and Export Control Committee comprised solely of independent directors to oversee trade compliance and national security risks.
quotes.for: National Security and Export Control Committee overseeing trade compliance and security risks.

quotes.text: NVIDIA is commencing a search to fill a new position, Chief Compliance Officer, to oversee compliance across NVIDIA and report to the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee. NVIDIA will continue to cooperate with ongoing government investigations and inquiries.
quotes.for: Search for a Chief Compliance Officer and continued cooperation with government inquiries.

quotes.text: “I am honored to return to NVIDIA and lead one of the most consequential technology companies in the world at the beginning of a new industrial revolution,” said Jensen Huang.
quotes.for: Jensen Huang statement on returning to lead Nvidia.

quotes.text: As previously announced, in light of recent reporting that Mr. Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, the Board formed a committee comprised solely of independent directors to investigate, and the committee retained independent counsel to assist it in that investigation.
quotes.for: Independent board committee retaining independent counsel to investigate reported foreign intelligence targeting.

quotes.text: The committee is engaging counsel with experience in national security matters, and such counsel will be retaining advisors with expertise in national security matters.
quotes.for: National Security and Export Control Committee engaging national security counsel and advisors.

title: NVIDIA Corporation Current Report on Form 8-K

quotes.text: On November 22, 2026, the Board of Directors of NVIDIA Corporation reinstated Jen-Hsun Huang as NVIDIA’s President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, effective immediately.
quotes.for: Form 8-K recording the board vote date as November 22, 2026.

quotes.text: Following the reinstatement of Mr. Huang, Ms. Kress will continue to serve as NVIDIA’s Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.
quotes.for: Colette Kress continuing as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer.

title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang. 'It's wrong, and it's shocking,' California AG Bonta says

quotes.text: Huang resigned as Nvidia’s chief executive on Nov. 12, after reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a Singapore-based businesswoman suspected by U.S. intelligence of being a Chinese spy.
quotes.for: November 12 resignation after reports of extramarital affairs and suspected intelligence ties.

quotes.text: “No national security risk? Based on what?” Sen. John Cornyn (R-Texas) wrote on X.
quotes.for: Republican Senator John Cornyn questioning the national security conclusion.

quotes.text: On Dec. 1, Huang is scheduled to testify in closed-door meetings with three Republican-led congressional committees.
quotes.for: December 1 closed-door testimony before three House committees.

quotes.text: On Monday, Republican Sen. Tim Scott, chairman of the Senate Banking Committee, announced that Huang would also testify in a public hearing on Dec. 3 titled “Protecting America’s AI Advantage: Oversight of U.S. Export Controls.”
quotes.for: December 3 Senate Banking Committee public hearing on export controls.

quotes.text: Meanwhile, in California, Atty. Gen. Rob Bonta said that the state Department of Justice would continue its investigation into whether confidential information or advanced chips were sent to China as well as whether Nvidia issued statements that misled investors or the public.
quotes.for: California Attorney General Rob Bonta continuing state DOJ investigation into Nvidia.

quotes.text: “It’s wrong, and it’s shocking,” Bonta said of Huang’s reinstatement.
quotes.for: Rob Bonta calling Huang reinstatement wrong and shocking.

quotes.text: “The Trump Administration’s rush to reinstate Jensen Huang underscores the need for Congress to act,” Senate minority leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) said in a statement.
quotes.for: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer statement criticizing the administration rush to reinstate Huang.

quotes.text: Schumer said Democrats will “wield their full power” to investigate any wrongdoing by Huang, Nvidia and the Trump administration.
quotes.for: Chuck Schumer pledging Democrats will investigate Huang, Nvidia and the Trump administration.

quotes.text: But as tech leaders and venture capitalists rejoiced — “The mistake has been corrected,” billionaire tech leader Elon Musk posted on X
quotes.for: Elon Musk posting on X that the mistake had been corrected.

title: 6 Questions About Jensen Huang's Stunning Return as Nvidia CEO

quotes.for: Eleven-day span between Huang resignation and reinstatement.

quotes.text: On Nov. 12, Huang stepped down from the company he co-founded in 1993 after acknowledging an extramarital affair

quotes.text: Trump told CNBC that he had spoken to Nvidia’s board “directly and indirectly,” and that Vice President JD Vance was also involved in discussions.

quotes.text: He has agreed to a transcribed congressional interview on Dec. 1 before the House Intelligence, Foreign Affairs, and China committees, and has also been asked to appear on Dec. 3 in a public Senate hearing.
quotes.for: December 1 transcribed House interview and December 3 public Senate hearing.

quotes.text: Notably, the board reinstated Huang before completing its independent investigation.

quotes.for: Morningstar director Lindsey Stewart saying the early reinstatement adds to investor corporate governance questions.

title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO

quotes.text: “The NVIDIA Board of Directors has made the correct and proper decision to return Jensen Huang to the position of CEO,” Trump wrote on Truth Social.
quotes.for: Trump Truth Social post calling the reinstatement the correct and proper decision.

quotes.text: “This reckless decision to bring back Jensen Huang does not change the fact that Huang and NVIDIA still owe Congress answers,” Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren posted on X.
quotes.for: Senator Elizabeth Warren statement on X demanding congressional answers.

quotes.text: He was reinstated despite multiple investigations under way into the chipmaker, including by the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) and the Department of Justice (DOJ).
quotes.for: Ongoing SEC and Department of Justice investigations into Nvidia.

quotes.text: Nvidia shares jumped by more than 33 percent on the news as US markets opened on Monday.
quotes.for: Nvidia stock jumping more than 33% as U.S. markets opened on November 23, 2026.

quotes.text: The tech-heavy Nasdaq was up 6.7 percent, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was up 2.8 percent and the S&P 500 was up 4.6 percent in early trading.
quotes.for: Early trading gains for Nasdaq (6.7%) and S&P 500 (4.6%) on November 23, 2026.

Trump also said he had discussed the shake-up with SpaceX and Tesla CEO Elon Musk last week. Trump claimed that Huang “did nothing wrong”.
quotes.for: Trump telling CNBC he was represented in the board meeting, spoke with Elon Musk, and claimed Huang did nothing wrong.

title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO after Trump intervenes

quotes.text: Nvidia shares surged on the news of Huang’s return, jumping 32% and adding more than $1tn (£760bn) to the company’s market value in New York on Monday, while Trump, who had persistently called for Huang’s return, said: “The country needs Jensen’s leadership.”
quotes.for: Nvidia shares jumping 32% and adding more than $1 trillion (£760 billion) in market value on November 23, 2026.

quotes.text: The same day as Huang’s reinstatement, the US government announced it had added Megaspeed to a federal trade blacklist, preventing US companies from selling chips or other advanced technology to the Singaporean business.
quotes.for: U.S. government adding Singapore-based Megaspeed to a federal trade blacklist on November 23, 2026.

quotes.text: The US president told CNBC the US had to “protect our geniuses”, adding that the Chinese president, Xi Jinping, praised Huang at last week’s Apec summit in Shenzhen.
quotes.for: Trump telling CNBC that the U.S. had to protect its geniuses and that Xi Jinping praised Huang at the APEC summit in Shenzhen.

quotes.text: Nvidia’s share price had fallen by a quarter in the days after Huang resigned on 12 November.
quotes.for: Nvidia share price falling by a quarter in the days after Huang resigned on November 12, 2026.

quotes.text: The Arm Holdings chief executive, Rene Haas, who had been approached to succeed Huang, has signed a new deal that will keep him in his current role until 2033.
quotes.for: Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas signing a new deal through 2033 after being approached to succeed Huang.
